home.lead: A family app to manage daily tasks, routines, stars, and rewards.

helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.lead: Choose a topic to learn how to use Tareitas.

loginSignup.title: Login / Signup description
loginSignup.initialAlt: LogIn / SignUp screen with the three setup options
loginSignup.threeOptions: On the LogIn / SignUp screen, you have three options:
loginSignup.createP1: This option is at the bottom of the LogIn / SignUp screen.
loginSignup.createP2: We recommend selecting “Different devices” and tapping Next.
loginSignup.createP3: Then, as the Admin, enter your email address and a 4-digit PIN. For the child, enter a login name (for example, childname1). The login name must be unique.
loginSignup.createAlt: Create a new group or family on the LogIn / SignUp screen, with Several devices selected
loginSignup.joinTitle: 2. Log in to (connect to) an existing group/family
loginSignup.joinP1: For example, you are a grandmother and your daughter asks you to help manage your grandchild’s chores.
loginSignup.joinP2: You can connect to multiple different groups/families.
loginSignup.joinAlt: Connect to an existing group or family with email and PIN
loginSignup.deviceTitle: 3. Log in to a family created only on this device
loginSignup.deviceP1: If you previously created a family that is stored only on this device, you can log in to that family.
loginSignup.deviceP2: However, we recommend selecting “Different devices”, as this option is more flexible and does not depend on a single device.
loginSignup.deviceAlt: Log in to a family stored only on this device
loginSignup.contact: If you have any additional questions, please contact us:

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Tareitas account
deleteAccount.lead: Enter the email address associated with your Tareitas account and pin code.
deleteAccount.codeSent: We sent a verification code to {email}.
deleteAccount.warning: This will permanently delete your Tareitas account and data (all children, parents, admin, associated images, users, tasks, rewards), including your child profiles, chores, rewards, images, and completion history.
deleteAccount.completeBody: Your Tareitas account and associated data have been deleted.
